name: JSONStructureCharacteristics
description: Meta-schema for JSON Structure: Characteristics. It validates the shape of each annotation defined by that specification: the presence and form of its members, the enumerations the specification states are closed, and the form required of a reference for the accompanying kind. It does not express a rule whose subject lies outside the annotated node.

ConceptsAddIn.name: ConceptsAddIn
ConceptsAddIn.description: Vocabulary characteristics. concepts MAY occur on a type definition and on a property, collection item, map value, or choice member schema.

concepts.description: Non-empty array of external term identities that the annotated node denotes.

ObservationPropertyAddIn.name: ObservationAddIn
ObservationPropertyAddIn.description: Observation and temporal characteristics carried directly on a property schema.

observedProperty.description: Identity of the observable that a result member carries.

semanticRole.description: Role the annotated member plays in an observation record.

derivation.description: How the annotated value was obtained.

statistic.description: Summary function applied. Present if and only if derivation is 'statistic'.

phenomenonTimeRelation.description: How the annotated value relates to the phenomenon time of its record.

temporalReferenceSystem.description: Temporal reference system in which the annotated position is expressed.

cadence.description: Expected recurrence pattern of the annotated temporal position.

referenceRole.description: Role the annotated member plays within a meta-type.

codedValues.description: External code list the annotated coded value is drawn from.

measurementConditioning.description: Frequency weighting, time weighting, and level reference the annotated scalar measurement carries.

ObservationArrayAddIn.name: ObservationAddIn
ObservationArrayAddIn.description: Observation and temporal characteristics carried on an array type, applying to its items.

ObservationSetAddIn.name: ObservationAddIn
ObservationSetAddIn.description: Observation and temporal characteristics carried on a set type, applying to its items.

ObservationMapAddIn.name: ObservationAddIn
ObservationMapAddIn.description: Observation and temporal characteristics carried on a map type, applying to its values.

ObservationChoiceAddIn.name: ObservationAddIn
ObservationChoiceAddIn.description: Observation and temporal characteristics carried on a choice type, applying to its members.

ObservationRecordObjectAddIn.name: ObservationRecordAddIn
ObservationRecordObjectAddIn.description: Characteristics that an object type carries and that bind existing members of it.

observedProperty.description: Identity of the observable that the annotated observation record describes.

temporalReferenceSystem.description: Temporal reference system of a temporal type, binding an existing member.

coordinateReferenceSystem.description: Spatial coordinate reference system, binding existing members as ordered coordinates.

vectorReferenceFrames.description: Reference frames on whose axes the components of vector quantities are resolved, binding existing members as ordered components.

tensorReferenceFrames.description: Reference frames on whose axes the components of tensor quantities are resolved, binding existing members as indexed components.

frameTransforms.description: Transformations from one reference frame to another, binding existing members as their components.

linearReferenceSystem.description: Linear reference system, binding existing members as linear element, measure, and direction.

colorSpaces.description: Color spaces in which channel values are expressed, binding existing members as ordered channels.

audioChannels.description: Audio channel groups in which sample values are interpreted, binding existing members as ordered channels.

spectralBands.description: Spectral band sets onto which multiband components are resolved, binding existing members as ordered bands.

ObservationRecordTupleAddIn.name: ObservationRecordAddIn
ObservationRecordTupleAddIn.description: Characteristics that a tuple type carries and that bind existing members of it.

ReferencedDefinition.description: Abstract base for a characteristic that identifies a definition by reference and classifies it by kind.

reference.description: Absolute URI identifying the definition, or a type reference { "$ref": <JSON Pointer> } to a shareable type definition in the annotated schema.

kind.description: Classification of the referenced definition. Open enumeration.

Concept.description: One external term identity. The kind enumeration is open.

kind.description: Sort of term identified. Values defined by the specification are 'rdfs-class', 'rdf-property', 'owl-class', 'owl-object-property', 'owl-datatype-property', 'skos-concept', and 'dcterms-property'. The enumeration is open.

ObservedProperty.description: Identity of an observable. The kind enumeration is open.

kind.description: Sort of observable definition identified. The enumeration is open.

Derivation.description: Closed enumeration stating how a value was obtained.

PhenomenonTimeRelation.description: Closed enumeration relating a value to the phenomenon time of its record.

ReferenceRole.description: Closed enumeration of roles within a meta-type.

SortOrder.description: Closed enumeration stating how encoded ordering runs relative to time.

FixedCadence.description: Cadence with a regular period. period is REQUIRED when kind is 'fixed'.

period.description: Positive interval in the applicable temporal reference system. A Core duration for datetime, date, or time.

UnscheduledCadence.description: Cadence without a regular period. period is prohibited.

Cadence.description: Expected recurrence pattern of a temporal position.

TemporalReferenceSystem.description: Temporal reference system in which a position is expressed.

kind.description: Sort of system identified. Values defined by the specification are 'ogc-trs', 'ogc-temporal-crs', and 'type'. The enumeration is open.

position.description: Name of the member that carries the temporal position. REQUIRED when the annotation is attached to an object or tuple.

sortOrder.description: Direction of the encoded ordering relative to time. Defaults to 'forward'.

CoordinateReferenceSystem.description: Spatial coordinate reference system binding existing members as ordered coordinates.

kind.description: Sort of system identified. Values defined by the specification are 'ogc-crs', 'epsg', and 'type'. The enumeration is open.

coordinates.description: Non-empty ordered array of distinct member names, one per coordinate axis, in axis order.

VectorReferenceFrame.description: One reference frame on whose axes the components of a vector quantity are resolved, binding existing members as ordered components.

kind.description: Sort of frame identified. Values defined by the specification are 'ogc-crs', 'epsg', and 'type'. The enumeration is open.

components.description: Non-empty ordered array of distinct member names, one per frame axis, in axis order.

variance.description: How the components respond to a change of frame. Defaults to 'contravariant'.

VectorReferenceFrames.description: Non-empty array of vector reference frames, one per vector quantity carried by the annotated type.

Variance.description: Closed enumeration stating how components respond to a change of frame.

FrameReference.description: Reference to one reference frame, by absolute URI or by type reference to a meta-type.

kind.description: Sort of frame identified. Values defined by the specification are 'ogc-crs', 'epsg', and 'type'. The enumeration is open.

variance.description: How the index in this position responds to a change of frame. Defaults to 'contravariant'.

TensorComponent.description: One component of a tensor, giving its index in each frame and the member that carries it.

index.description: Non-negative integers, one per entry in frames, giving the position of this component.

property.description: Name of the member carrying this component.

TensorComponents.description: Non-empty array of indexed tensor components.

TensorReferenceFrame.description: One tensor quantity, bound to the frames whose axes its indices range over.

frames.description: Frames whose axes the indices range over, in index order. The number of entries is the rank of the tensor.

components.description: Either the name of a member holding an array nested to the rank of the tensor, first frame outermost, or an array of components each stating its own index.

symmetry.description: How positions named by no component are determined. Permitted only where frames has exactly two entries naming the same frame.

TensorReferenceFrames.description: Non-empty array of tensor quantities carried by the annotated type.

TransformEncoding.description: Closed enumeration naming the arrangement of numbers that carries a transformation.

RotationSequence.description: Closed enumeration of the twelve axis sequences for intrinsic Euler rotations. The leftmost letter names the axis of the first rotation.

TransformComponentNames.description: Ordered array of distinct member names in the order this specification fixes for the encoding: three for eulerAngles, four for quaternion and axisAngle.

FrameTransform.description: One transformation carrying coordinates in the from frame into coordinates in the to frame.

from.description: Frame the transformation carries coordinates out of. variance is prohibited here.

to.description: Frame the transformation carries coordinates into. variance is prohibited here.

encoding.description: Arrangement of numbers that carries the transformation.

components.description: For quaternion, axisAngle, and eulerAngles, an ordered array of member names. For rotationMatrix and homogeneousMatrix, either the name of a member holding an array nested twice, row outermost, or an array of components each stating its own index, row first.

rotationSequence.description: Axis sequence of the three intrinsic rotations. Present if and only if encoding is 'eulerAngles'.

translation.description: Names of the three members carrying the origin offset, resolved on the axes of the to frame in that frame's axis order. Prohibited when encoding is 'homogeneousMatrix'.

FrameTransforms.description: Non-empty array of transformations carried by the annotated type.

AlphaMode.description: Closed enumeration stating how channel values stand to an opacity value.

ColorTransfer.description: Closed enumeration stating whether channel values carry the transfer function of the identified space or are proportional to light.

ColorSpace.description: Color space in which channel values held in members of the annotated type are expressed.

kind.description: Sort of definition identified. Values defined by the specification are 'itu', 'iec', 'cie', 'icc-profile', 'icc-registry', and 'type'. The enumeration is open.

codePoints.description: Color primaries, transfer characteristics, matrix coefficients, and video full range flag of ITU-T H.273, in that order.

channels.description: Non-empty ordered array of distinct member names, one per channel of the space, in the order the identified definition declares them.

alpha.description: Name of the member carrying opacity. Distinct from every name in channels.

alphaMode.description: How the channel values stand to the opacity value. Permitted only where alpha is present. Defaults to 'straight'.

transfer.description: Whether the channel values carry the transfer function of the identified space. Defaults to 'asDefined'.

illuminant.description: Standard illuminant the values are relative to, using a designation of CIE 015.

observer.description: Standard colorimetric observer the values are relative to. Values defined by the specification are 'cie-1931-2' and 'cie-1964-10'. The enumeration is open.

ColorSpaces.description: Non-empty array of color spaces carried by the annotated type.

AudioChannel.description: One audio channel group. The kind enumeration is open; levelReference and encoding are closed.

kind.description: Sort of definition identified. Values defined by the specification are 'itu' and 'type'. The enumeration is open.

channels.description: Non-empty ordered array of distinct member names, one per channel of the layout, in the order the identified definition declares them.

levelReference.description: What the sample amplitudes are relative to. Defaults to 'fullScale'.

encoding.description: How the stored numbers stand to amplitude. Defaults to 'linear'.

AudioChannels.description: Non-empty array of audio channel groups carried by the annotated type.

AudioLevelReference.description: Closed enumeration of audio level references.

AudioEncoding.description: Closed enumeration of audio sample encodings.

SpectralBand.description: One spectral band set. The kind and calibration enumerations are open.

kind.description: Sort of definition identified. Values defined by the specification are 'sensor' and 'type'. The enumeration is open.

bands.description: Non-empty ordered array of distinct member names, one per band of the set, in the order the identified definition declares them.

calibration.description: What physical quantity each band value is. Values defined by the specification are 'digitalNumber', 'radiance', and 'reflectance'. The enumeration is open.

SpectralBands.description: Non-empty array of spectral band sets carried by the annotated type.

CodedValues.description: Code list the annotated coded value is drawn from. The kind enumeration is open.

kind.description: Sort of register the identified list belongs to. Values defined by the specification are 'wmo-codes', 'iso', 'unlocode', 'icao', 'iata', 'iana', 'icd', 'snomed-ct', 'loinc', 'atc', 'unspsc', and 'type'. The enumeration is open.

MeasurementConditioning.description: Frequency weighting, time weighting, and level reference a scalar measurement carries. At least one member is present; the enumerations are open.

weighting.description: Frequency weighting. Values defined by the specification are 'a', 'c', and 'z'. The enumeration is open.

timeWeighting.description: Time weighting. Values defined by the specification are 'fast' and 'slow'. The enumeration is open.

levelReference.description: What the level is relative to: 'soundPressure' or an absolute URI identifying another reference.

LinearReferenceSystem.description: Linear reference system binding existing members as linear element, measure, and direction.

kind.description: Sort of system identified. Values defined by the specification are 'lrs-network' and 'type'. The enumeration is open.

linearElement.description: Name of the member that identifies the linear element.

measure.description: Name of the member that carries the measure along the linear element.

measureEnd.description: Name of the member that carries the end measure of a linear extent.

direction.description: Name of the member that carries the direction of measurement.
